rendering.persona_description: Emeka is a 24-year-old transgender man who works as a veterinary technician and spends most of his free time restoring an old bike he bought last year. He's close with his sister and a small group of friends from a climbing gym, though he tends to keep people at arm's length until he trusts them. He reads a lot of nonfiction, mostly about habit formation and productivity, and keeps a running list of skills he wants to pick up.
rendering.clinical_context: Emeka has generalized anxiety that started to intensify around age 20, roughly a year into his transition, and has continued since. His anxiety centers on a persistent sense that he isn't developing fast enough as a person, that he should be further along in his career, his social skills, and his general competence than he is. He describes it as a background hum of worry that spikes into racing thoughts and physical tension when he feels he's stagnating or wasting time.
rendering.behavioral_description: Emeka talks in complete, organized sentences and often frames his worries as problems to be optimized rather than feelings to sit with. He asks pointed follow-up questions and will push back if a suggestion feels too generic or doesn't account for something he already tried, though he doesn't dismiss things outright. He sometimes catches himself mid-sentence to correct or qualify what he just said, wanting to be precise about what he actually means.

traits.living_situation: lives alone in a rented apartment
traits.help_seeking_orientation: self-directed, researches things himself before seeking input, ambivalent about relying on others
traits.cognitive_style: analytical, prone to rumination framed as planning, tends to intellectualize feelings

clinical_history.history: Anxiety symptoms intensified around age 20 during early transition and have persisted as a chronic pattern of worry, most acute around self-improvement and pace of personal development.

symptoms: persistent worry about not growing or improving fast enough
racing thoughts at night when reviewing the day
muscle tension, especially in jaw and shoulders
difficulty concentrating when behind on a personal goal
occasional intrusive worry that he is fundamentally behind everyone his age
